name: Her Letters
source:
In this short story, April and May have been friends for 15 years now. Nothing has ever changed that. But now that they're going to universities 3 hours apart, things are... different. May, oblivious to the deterioration happening around her, quickly learns that life sucks. Like Murphy's Law states, anything that can happen will happen.

We follow May's online conversations with her best friend April through their fourth year of university. April, an aspiring writer, continuously sends May letters. Letters that have been piling up in various spots of May's dorm over the last few months. It may be too late when she finds out what's really in her letters.
translation:
在这个短篇故事中，April和May已经是15年的朋友了。一切都没有改变过。但现在他们去大学的时间相隔3个小时，事情就……不同了。梅没有注意到周围发生的恶化，很快就发现生活很糟糕。正如墨菲定律所说，任何可能发生的事情都会发生。

我们追踪梅与她最好的朋友阿普丽尔在大学四年级的在线对话。阿普丽尔是一位有抱负的作家，她不断地给梅寄来信。过去几个月里，梅宿舍的各个地方都堆满了信件。当她发现信中的真实内容时可能为时已晚。
